content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-109. - Surpluses and deficiencies.

           …

faqs.a:
(a)
Should any assessment prove insufficient to pay for the project or the work for which
               it is levied and the expense incident thereto, the amount of such deficiency shall
               be paid from the general fund of the city, from its capital improvements fund or from
               such other account in which moneys are accounted for which may be made available for
               such purpose by the council.
(b)
If a greater amount has been collected than was necessary, the excess shall be transferred
               as provided in
section 78-90
.
(Code 1981, § 27-110; Ord. No. 551, § 50, 5-14-1964)
